english.title: Breach disqualification order for certain offences involving dogs
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) breached a disqualification order made by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) under section 66 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022, in that **(..SPECIFY BREACH..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 66(6) and (7) of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
breached a disqualification order
made under section 66 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Disqualification orders under section 66 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022 may be made where a person is convicted of a specific offence and a doc was used in or was present at the commission of the offence.
(ii) This applies to offences under section 1 of the Night Poaching Act 1828 (taking or destroying game or rabbits by night or entering land for that purpose); section 30 of the Game Act 1831 (trespass in daytime in search of game etc); section 63 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022 (trespass with intent to search for or to pursue hares with dogs etc) and under section 64 of that Act (being equipped for searching for or pursuing hares with dogs etc).
